question: Circulation aur collector commemorative coins mein kya farq hai?
essence: Commemorative coin ka everyday use, legal-tender status aur collector price alag baatein hain.
answer: Book commemorative coins ko fiat money batati hai, lekin legal tender hona coin par depend karta hai; book ke mutabik most legal tender hote hain. Circulation commemorative coins ordinary coins ki tarah use ke liye circulation mein release hote hain. Collector coins Government Mint ke proof ya UNC sets mein bikte hain aur everyday transactions mein rarely use hote hain. [p004–p005]
deep_dive: Book ka ₹100 silver commemorative coin example: legally ₹100 payment ki ja sakti hai, par collectors several thousand rupees de sakte hain. Payment ke liye denomination aur collectible ke liye market price ko mix na karein. Yeh example har commemorative coin ke legal-tender status ki guarantee nahi hai. [p005]
